# Will the project pay before your cash runs out?

> Free subcontractor cash flow planner: see the funding gap from payment terms, retention and late payment — what bridging it costs, and which lever closes it.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.

## Pages

- [Subcontractor Cash Flow Planner vs. Billd Material Financing](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/subcontractor-cashflow-planner/vs-billd.html)
- [Subcontractor Cash Flow Planner vs. treating materials as cash out on day one](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/subcontractor-cashflow-planner/vs-treating-materials-as-cash-out-on-day-one.html)
